novel_policies.label: arbitration clause allowed
novel_policies.quote: Nothing in this act shall preclude the court from setting aside an arbitration clause on any basis permitted under Pennsylvania law.

novel_policies.label: change order must be written
novel_policies.quote: Deviate from or disregard plans or specifications, in any material respect, without a written change order dated and signed by both the contractor and owner

novel_policies.label: contract must be written
novel_policies.quote: No home improvement contract shall be valid or enforceable against an owner unless it: Is in writing and legible

novel_policies.label: deposit cap contract threshold usd
novel_policies.quote: for a home improvement contract in which the total price is more than $5,000

novel_policies.label: deposit cap fraction
novel_policies.quote: for a home improvement contract in which the total price is more than $5,000, receive a deposit in excess of one-third of the home improvement contract price

novel_policies.label: enhanced penalty for elderly victims
novel_policies.quote: Where a person commits an offense under subsection (a) and the victim is 60 years of age or older, the grading of the offense shall be one grade higher

novel_policies.label: fraud felony threshold usd
novel_policies.quote: a felony of the third degree if the amount involved exceeds $2,000

novel_policies.label: fraud offense defined
novel_policies.quote: A person commits the offense of home improvement fraud if, with intent to defraud or injure anyone or with knowledge that he is facilitating a fraud or injury to be perpetrated by anyone

novel_policies.label: insurance personal injury minimum usd
novel_policies.quote: proof of liability insurance covering personal injury in an amount not less than $50,000

novel_policies.label: insurance property damage minimum usd
novel_policies.quote: insurance covering property damage caused by the work of a home improvement contractor in an amount not less than $50,000

novel_policies.label: does not require bonding
novel_policies.quote: The board may, at its discretion, require any contractor who has had action taken against his/her registration to obtain a bond in such amount as determined by the board.

novel_policies.label: degree level: high school
novel_policies.quote: Possesses a high school diploma or a High School Equivalency Diploma

novel_policies.label: does not require moral character
novel_policies.quote: no specialty section of the board shall adopt, maintain, renew, or enforce any rule, or otherwise preclude in any way, an individual from renewing a license under this chapter due to any past criminal activity or interpretation of moral character.

novel_policies.label: lacks scope protection
novel_policies.quote: A contractor who is not registered with the director as required by this chapter shall not be awarded a contract to perform work for the state or an agency of the state.

novel_policies.label: local trade licensing preserved
novel_policies.quote: This provision does not affect existing licensing standards in effect on the effective date of this act, with respect to electricians and plumbers and other trades, where licensing is conditioned on requirements of testing or possession of certificates obtained through specific training in electricity or plumbing or other trades.

novel_policies.label: minimum annual revenue threshold usd
novel_policies.quote: A person for whom the total cash value of all of that person's home improvements is less than $5,000 during the previous taxable year.

novel_policies.label: minimum project value usd
novel_policies.quote: the total cash price of all work agreed upon between the contractor and owner is more than $500

novel_policies.label: out of state disciplinary action reporting required
novel_policies.quote: Any disciplinary action taken in such other jurisdiction shall be reported to the bureau on the initial registration application or, if such action occurred subsequent to submission of an initial application, on the biennial registration application or within 90 days of final disposition, whichever is sooner.

novel_policies.label: lacks state preempts local registration fees
registration number required in ads
novel_policies.quote: A contractor shall include its registration number in all advertisements distributed within this Commonwealth and on all contracts, estimates and proposals with owners in this Commonwealth.

novel_policies.label: registration renewal interval years
novel_policies.quote: Any registered contractor in this Commonwealth who is registered or licensed as a home improvement contractor in any other state, or political subdivision thereof, shall report this information to the bureau on the initial registration and biennial registration application.

novel_policies.label: right of rescission days
novel_policies.quote: shall be permitted to rescind the contract without penalty regardless of where the contract was signed, within three business days of the date of signing

novel_policies.label: self insurance permitted
novel_policies.quote: proof of insurance may include information attested to by an applicant that the applicant is self-insured and the bureau shall develop forms for this purpose

novel_policies.label: state preempts local registration fees
novel_policies.quote: Registration under this act shall preclude any requirement of payment of a fee or registration or licensing of any home improvement contractor by any political subdivision.

novel_policies.label: voidable contract clauses
novel_policies.quote: If a home improvement contract contains any of the following clauses, the home improvement contract shall be voidable by the owner: A hold harmless clause. A waiver of Federal, State or local health, life, safety or building code requirements. A confession of judgment clause.

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: If continuing education or other requirements are made a condition of license reinstatement after lapse, suspension, or revocation, these requirements must be satisfied before the license is reissued.

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: There is created the Residential Contractors Committee, to consist of seven (7) members.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: The governor shall appoint a registrar of contractors pursuant to section 38-211. The registrar shall serve at the pleasure of the governor. The registrar is vested with all functions and duties relating to administration of this chapter.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a shared board
novel_policies.quote: One member of the board shall be a general engineering contractor, two members shall be general building contractors, two members shall be specialty contractors, one member shall be a member of a labor organization representing the building trades, one member shall be an active local building official, and eight members shall be public members

novel_policies.quote: A contractor doing business in this state shall register with the director and shall meet all of the following requirements as a condition of registration
